title: Union Minister Inspects Jalandhar Cantt Railway Station Redevelopment
summary: Union minister Ravneet Bittu inspected the redeveloped Jalandhar Cantt railway station, which is part of a larger project to improve infrastructure in the region. The development aims to enhance passenger facilities and security measures for pilgrims visiting nearby Amarnath. This initiative is part of the government's efforts to modernize its transportation network.
summary_points: Union Minister Ravneet Bittu inspected the redeveloped Jalandhar Cantt railway station
The development aims to enhance passenger facilities and security measures for pilgrims visiting nearby Amarnath
This initiative is part of the government's efforts to modernize its transportation network
The project involves improvements to infrastructure in the region
The redeveloped station is expected to benefit pilgrims and locals alike
